criteria.reason: Independent baseline module fixture reproduces rolling 3711.3735 RPM versus locked/spinning 4950 RPM. Current supplied regression passes 4/4; normal fixtures include forward and reverse cancellation. Signed components are added before magnitude.

Independently ran current npm test: 27/27, including all unchanged historical tests and six integrated RPM cases. Independent TypeScript no-emit check passed. No simulation coefficient or existing assertion-bound retune.

Independently regenerated all seven scenarios in memory and deep-compared all 5700 sample objects with recorded JSON; exact equality. Recomputed every maximum mismatch. Actual rolling scenario visits gears 1 through 5.

Unused optional contact-speed argument removed. Failed contact-projection experiment and strict ramp failure retained. Body-forward and rear-contact states are explicitly distinguished and their mismatch quantified. This bounded defect repair does not claim an authoritative unified rear-wheel rotational state.

independent_checks.method: Read baseline drivetrain through git show and stripTypeScriptTypes, then 24-tick rolling/lock/spin fixture
independent_checks.result: Reproduced original regression independently without modifying original source

independent_checks.method: Read-only Node/tsx replay of all seven trace scenarios, assert.deepEqual on every sample and strict equality on maximum mismatch
independent_checks.result: 5700 samples exactly matched; evidence was not overwritten

limitations: Powertrain samples tick-start body-forward velocity plus previous overspeed. Rear wheel phase uses contact-projected speed plus overspeed updated during this tick. These are different model states despite shared algebra.

The maximum recorded discrepancy is 7.070313492876565 rad/s during wet traction loss/recovery. This is disclosed and accepted only within the existing provisional simcade model, not OEM drivetrain validation.
Original lock failure and corrected cancellation are controlled module fixtures; integrated traces are not claimed to independently reproduce a physically validated locked tire.
No new browser/video, normal-speed driving feel, hardware frame-time, physical controller or audio approval is issued by this targeted source review. P03A art and G3 are outside this decision.
